title: El mérito no basta: por qué México necesita igualdad de oportunidades
title_en: Merit is not enough: why Mexico needs equality of opportunity
description: Why rewarding observed merit is not the same as fairness: through two students sitting the same high-school entrance exam from very different starting points, the piece reviews the evidence on inequality of opportunity in Mexico and assesses the 2025 reform that replaced the Comipems exam.

title: México y su escalera educativa: todos suben, pero unos empiezan desde el sótano
title_en: Mexico's educational ladder: everyone climbs, but some start in the basement
description: A look at the paradox of educational expansion in Mexico: each generation completes more years of schooling than the last, yet a parent's own education level remains the strongest predictor of a child's educational trajectory.

title: tstsqa: Bias Reduction for TSTS Imputation via Quantile Adjustment
description: R package implementing the quantile adjustment method from my job market paper: qa_fit() restores the imputed income distribution and shifts its covariance with the second variable, and qa_diagnose() screens predictors and checks whether the adjustment is likely to help before you run it.

title: GEOM: Functions for Estimating Inequality of Opportunity
description: R functions for estimating ex-ante and ex-post inequality of opportunity, developed for the Global Estimates of Opportunity and Mobility (GEOM) database, with tools for plotting trees, ECDFs and related figures.

title: Baladí Radio
description: Baladí is a Berlin-based radio project pairing field recordings with curated and experimental music to capture the sonic identity of different cities around the world.
role: Audio-visual recording · hosted by Fede and Java
